top_signals.title: Trucking Recession Continues: Why Carriers Face Layoffs and Bankruptcies
top_signals.summary:
The freight market is seeing some interesting trends with mixed volumes and rising rates across modes, but small carriers are under immense pressure. We’re breaking down tender rejections, spot rates, and contract rates, highlighting why some carriers face layoffs and bankruptcies despite a recovering market. Plus, learn about the lowest truck count since early 2022. […]

The post Trucking Recession Continues: Why Carriers Face Layoffs and Bankruptcies appeared first on FreightWaves.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Freightos’ founder accuses company of ‘rigging’ proxy vote as company opposes his proposals
top_signals.summary:
Freightos' board unanimously recommended rejecting three proposals from founder and former CEO Zvi Schreiber ahead of the company's Dec. 16 annual general meeting, setting up a shareholder vote on leadership, governance and business strategy.

The post Freightos’ founder accuses company of ‘rigging’ proxy vote as company opposes his proposals appeared first on FreightWaves.
